purpose: Teach: 非合法/謀略/疎外/破裂/充満/退学/単発/創世

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、非合法な集会を警察、解散されましたね
lines.en: So the police dispersed what was technically an illegal gathering, didn't they?
lines.style: Measured, analytical opening. Ren is working through the logic aloud, not accusing. Slight lift on the question-mark — genuinely seeking confirmation. Thoughtful pace, like he's connecting dots as he speaks.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の謀略を解明します
lines.en: The police are working to clarify the suspect's motives and actions behind it all.
lines.style: Direct, official tone without coldness. Takeda states fact — he's briefing, not lecturing. Steady breath, calm authority. Small emphasis on the investigative work itself, not the drama of it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者が疎外感を抱えた経緯を警察、把握されてますね
lines.en: The police understand how the victim came to feel isolated — that's part of the picture here, isn't it?
lines.style: Slower, more careful. Ren is reaching for the human element beneath the case file. Gentle precision in his phrasing. Trailing slightly on the question, inviting agreement rather than pushing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ガス管の破裂事案にも対応します
lines.en: The police are also handling the gas pipe rupture that occurred at the scene.
lines.style: Factual pivot without hesitation. Takeda moves to the next piece of the incident — practical, no wasted words. Level delivery, indicating this is part of the documented chain of events.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、煙が充満した現場での救出を警察、なさいましたね
lines.en: And you carried out the rescue operation in that smoke-filled space — that was the police response, wasn't it?
lines.style: Quiet respect beneath the question. Ren is acknowledging the immediate danger without making it performative. Slight lean forward in his voice, recognizing the human cost of procedure. Gentle question-lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、退学者の更生にも関わります
lines.en: The police are also involved in the rehabilitation of those who've left the group.
lines.style: Continuity-focused. Takeda connects rescue to recovery — the work doesn't end when the immediate crisis does. Steady, broader-lens pacing. Compassionate without sentiment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、単発事件として警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So this will be handled as an isolated incident, then — that's how the police are approaching it?
lines.style: Checking for confirmation, but there's a subtle doubt beneath. Ren's pacing slows; he's asking the question he's already half-afraid of the answer to. Slight hesitation before the question, like he knows it matters.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、創世神話に基づいた信仰団体の動向も把握します
lines.en: The police are monitoring the activities of this belief group — they claim authority from creation mythology — because we need to understand the broader pattern.
lines.style: Shift to quieter intensity. Takeda's pace tightens; he's revealing something more serious now. No apology in his voice, but respect for what he's about to say. Weight on 'broader pattern' — this is the real concern.
